name: shipit
description: Spec-driven development for any repo. run executes an existing issue ID or URL through native planner, builder and delivery subagents with pinned stage models, refreshed main and resumable QA. Individual init, design-system, task, plan, implement and handoff skills remain available; handoff.allow controls external effects.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, implement and deliver work under a contract generated from your own repo
interface.longDescription: Spec-driven development for any repo. run executes an existing issue ID or URL through native planner, builder and delivery subagents with pinned stage models, refreshed main and resumable QA. Individual init, design-system, task, plan, implement and handoff skills remain available; handoff.allow controls external effects.
defaultPrompt: Run shipit init on this repo.
Set up the design system for this repo with shipit.
Turn this need into a ticket with shipit.
Run shipit on this existing issue ID or URL and deliver it for human QA.
